prose: Dwarkesh Patel announced the winners of his 'Big Questions About AI' essay contest - over 600 submissions. First place: Jassi Pannu (Assistant Professor at Johns Hopkins, biosecurity and pandemic preparedness, board member of Blueprint Biosecurity), answering what the OpenAI Foundation should do: she argues we can live in a post-disease world and gives concrete plans for dedicating tens of billions of dollars to it.
Second place: Ege Erdil, co-founder of Mechanize (environments and evals for frontier coding agents). The post publishes all three winning essays in full.
highlights: 600+ essays submitted to Dwarkesh's Big Questions contest
Winner Jassi Pannu: the OpenAI Foundation should fund a post-disease world
Her proposal: concrete plans for tens of billions toward pandemic preparedness
Second place: Ege Erdil, Mechanize co-founder (coding-agent evals)
All three winning essays published in full in the post
